lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Old-Timer!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: You've gotta help me!

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Help!
What's wrong?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Ether is calling me in for a health exam.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Why should I have to do that?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I haven't been sick in ages, and I feel right as rain.
Maybe she thinks you've been eating too much?

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I don't eat that much!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Me neither!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Sure, I typically eat enough meat for 12 people,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: and I once ate 200 takoyakis,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: which was a new record,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: but that was a special occasion! I don't eat that much all the time.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I'm fit as a fiddle.
That may be true now, but it might deteriorate as time goes on.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Uh-oh.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I can't let that happen.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: You're free to eat as much as you want,

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: but I want you to stick around for a long while yet,

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: so you've got to stay healthy.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: But I'm as healthy as can be right now!

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I've warned you countless times before about your food portions.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Mountains of rice, fountain drinks the size of swimming pools...

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: You wolf them all down with reckless abandon.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: You just said I could eat as much as I like!

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Yes,

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: but if you want to continue eating as much as you like,

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: you've got to mind your health.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: So, let's go and get a health exam done together.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Wait...

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: you'll come too?

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I sure will.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Fine.
I'll make an appointment for you both.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Thanks, Old-Timer.
